description: Fetches basic identification metadata about the active Revit project. Returns the document title and file path. Use this for lightweight project identification.
name: fetch_project_info

description: Fetches all levels in the active Revit project. Returns each level's name, UniqueId, and elevation in feet. Use this before placing family instances or when you need elevation context.
name: fetch_levels

description: Fetches all existing reference gridlines in the active Revit project. Returns each grid's name, UniqueId, and the start/end point coordinates of its curve. Use this before creating new grids to check names and determine spacing.
name: fetch_grids

description: Fetches all loaded family symbols (types) in the active Revit project. Returns a dictionary mapping family names to lists of their available type names. Use this before placing a family instance to verify the family and type are loaded.
name: fetch_families

description: Fetches all existing drawing sheets in the active Revit project. Returns each sheet's number, name, and UniqueId. Use this before creating a new sheet to avoid duplicate sheet numbers.
name: fetch_sheets

description: Places a loaded family symbol instance at a specified 3D coordinate on a given level in the active Revit project.
name: place_family

type_name.description: The type name within the family (e.g. '36" x 84"').

family_name.description: The exact name of the family (e.g. 'Single-Flush').

level_id.description: The UniqueId of the host level element.

description: Creates a linear reference gridline between two XY points in the active Revit project.
name: create_grid

name.description: Display name of the grid (e.g. 'Grid A', 'Grid 1').

description: Creates a new drawing sheet in the active Revit project using the first available Title Block family.
name: create_sheet

sheet_name.description: Descriptive title of the sheet (e.g. 'FIRST FLOOR PLAN').
